plain_english: What you see is the best rule we found by searching 5297 valid strategy combinations on data the models had not seen; this one came out on top (Sharpe 1.49 vs 0.89 for buy-and-hold SPY). Honesty checks: (1) the typical strategy in our search scored 0.76, so the winner may be among the luckier of many tries; (2) a re-shuffle test puts the chance of a result this good at about 7.1% (we want under 5% before calling it real); (3) durability across historical episodes is 'conditionally_durable' and the signal-market relationship is 'sign_unstable' over time. New Home Sales growth DID lead SPY in the formal causality test, consistent with housing being an early-cycle leading indicator, so read this as a search result, not an independently validated forecasting signal. No fresh confirmation test (final exam) on untouched data has been run yet.
